# Change summary

## Requirement / reason
Describe the requirement and why this change is necessary.

## Risk class
- [ ] R0
- [ ] R1
- [ ] R2
- [ ] R3
- [ ] R4

## Architecture / ADR impact
List affected ADRs or state `None`.

## Threat / failure review
What could fail, expand authority, expose host data, or prevent recovery?

## Pre-change validation
- [ ] Current state recorded
- [ ] Dependencies/conflicts checked
- [ ] Scope bounded to project-owned resources

## Rollback
Describe the exact rollback trigger and procedure.

## Automated validation
Record syntax/PSScriptAnalyzer/compliance results as applicable.

## Manual acceptance test
Record required manual tests and expected outcomes.

## Evidence
Provide sanitized evidence references only. Do not commit credentials, secrets, sensitive host/network data, VM exports, or private logs.

## Independent review
- [ ] Build perspective
- [ ] Audit perspective
- [ ] Adversarial perspective
- [ ] Recovery perspective

## Post-change review
State observed final condition, residual risk, and whether the change is ready for `ACCEPTED` status.
